summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundle on install
details: The package's declared preinstall script runs setup.mjs, which at install time downloads a Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (v1.3.13), makes it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js inside a temp directory. math_init.js is a ~727KB obfuscated bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, containing a rotated string-array with a rotator function (`WV8StW`) — the string-array-rotation obfuscation shape — and opaque identifiers. setup.mjs itself is also obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex-suffixed identifiers `_0x488df8`/`_0x52943e` for fs/https, per-function split-key lookup objects like `_0x19328d.YCZJE(execFileSync,...)` to indirect the execFileSync and https calls), which hides the download-and-exec behavior from casual inspection. The combination of alternate-runtime execution at preinstall and a heavily obfuscated payload means the code that actually runs on the installer machine is not reachable to Node-based review tooling and is not readable in source form. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: `npm install` of this package pulls a second runtime and hands it a large obfuscated bundle for arbitrary execution on the installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
